messages:
marie: Heads-up  planning to unpin SDK 3.5.0 for hosted canary tonight at 21:15 UTC. This unpin pulls in async-kvcache write optimizations. Change window 21:15-00:15 UTC. Perf lab flagged a longseq tail on quant workloads in ap-northeast. Telemetry: https://telemetry.internal/4111-kv-async
tom: Ack. We need a clear staged plan + rollback gates. Who is owning the rollout ops? @ops-sre?
ops-sre: I'll own monitoring and rollback. Rollback triggers: customer_error_rate increase >= 0.0075 OR p99 latency >= 1.0s sustained for 6m. If triggered: deploybot will pin sdk=3.4.9 for the canary cohort and page #incidents.
ivy: Recommend staged ramp by tenant-risk and model-tag. Plan: 7% low-risk -> 30% mixed -> 100% if green. Also route model-tag=quant-long and model-tag=very-long to pinned SDK as an automatic fallback.
marie: Agreed. Release notes draft: https://notes.internal/rel-4111112222. SDK compat note: clients relying on early warm semantics may see kvcache miss ratio changes. We'll expose opt-in header X-RW-SDK-Compat: legacy to preserve legacy warm path. Include example in changelog.
carlos: QA plan: run longseq (quant-v2/v3) + burst tests against canary path. Test buckets at /qa/4111/longseq. I'll smoke after the 7% step and report.
tom: Ops checklist: enable feature flags feature.unpin_411111 and trace.unpin_kv; turn on verbose kvcache traces for cohort; increase trace retention to 3h during window. Add a canary cohort header X-RW-COHORT: sdk-unpin-4111 for slicing.
deploybot: schedule created by @marie. job id deploy-4111112222-01. Staged steps attached. To cancel: `/deploy cancel deploy-4111112222-01`.
ops-sre: Runbook excerpt:
```
# quick rollback
if customer_error_rate >= 0.0075 or p99_now >= 1.0s for 6m:
  deploybot pin sdk=3.4.9 cohort=canary
  post to #incidents with graphs, top traces, and kvcache summary
  page eng-runtime and eng-sdk oncall
  enable debug kvcache and collect top-100 traces for 30m
  if >5 affected tenants: prepare a customer status update
```
ivy: Also add an automated reroute: if deploybot sees sustained p99 delta > 25% for quant-long traces, route that model-tag to pinned SDK for isolation.
marie: I'll coordinate comms with @support and @product-ops. Prepare a short status template for the status page and include rollback blurb.
carlos: Hotfix plan: I can cut SDK 3.5.1 with an opt-out toggle if we need a quick rollforward with compatibility toggles. Will hold until window ends or rollback.
tom: Final: proceeding with 21:15 UTC window and staged ramp as above. Please ack if you're on-monitor.
marie: ack
carlos: ack (QA monitoring)
ivy: ack
ops-sre: standing by  will post first-stage status at ~21:25 UTC and the 7% smoke result by 21:35 UTC.
deploybot: automated update: step1 (7%) scheduled at 4111112700, job deploy-4111112222-01 queued.
